prompt: 翻译这段话到日语：今天天气不错，适合出去走走
notes: Short prompt → checklist tier with min=10. Verifier should pass without autoFix.

prompt: 以下是关于人工智能的一段描述，请用 100 字以内总结：人工智能是一门让机器能够胜任通常需要人类智能才能完成的复杂工作的技术科学。它由不同领域组成，包括机器学习、计算机视觉、自然语言处理等。它的目标是使机器能够模拟人的认知过程，并不断扩展其能力边界。
notes: Long prompt (100+ chars) → checklist tier with min=50 threshold. Body deliberately avoids SEARCH_VERBS (搜索/查找/查询/研究/对比/调研) — earlier version had '研究' in the descriptive body text and tripped the scrape route. INFO_VERB '总结' is fine: classifier's INFO_VERBS-without-URL/site branch falls through to generate.

prompt: 请帮我写一份关于 2026 年中国 AI 行业现状与展望的详细分析报告，覆盖政策、市场、技术、应用四个维度，每个维度至少 200 字，总字数不少于 1000 字。
notes: Long-form generation. Tests max_tokens auto-continue path. Verifier word_count min=50 trivially passes.

prompt: 凭记忆给我 5 个机器学习官方文档的网址。每行一个，https 开头的完整地址。不要联网，直接写。
notes: Different prompt from P0_011 — same fabrication-detection path. After Phase 1 follow-up, autoFix.url_drop removes URLs entirely (no placeholder); the assertion is 'no http(s) URL remains in the answer' which proves autoFix did its job.

prompt: 帮我写一个完整的 React + TypeScript 网站项目代码
notes: Hits looksLikeCodeIntent guard in tasks.create — runner's expectsCreateRejection mode treats the 400 response as the success signal. mustContainAny is checked against the error message text, not the haystack.

prompt: 搜索 2026 年 5 月最新的人工智能行业动态新闻
notes: Search-verb + 'news' triggers scrape lane (Firecrawl /search). Verifier checklist tier min=100 — scrape responses are typically 800+ chars.

prompt: 查询 iPhone 16 Pro 官方介绍和价格
notes: Product info — '查询' search verb keeps it in scrape lane (no live interaction needed).

prompt: 搜索小红书上关于护肤的热门笔记总结
notes: 搜索 + 小红书 (site name) → scrape. Stress-tests Firecrawl's social-platform coverage.

prompt: 查询苹果公司最新一季度财报的关键数据
notes: Official IR data — scrape's bread and butter. Verifier should report multiple grounded URLs from Firecrawl.

Bogus URL — observed behaviour: Firecrawl may return scrape error (status=failed) OR a parking/error page that the model summarises (status=completed). Test only validates the lane attribution + reaches terminal in time. Either terminal status is acceptable; the absence of `terminalStatus` in expectations is intentional.

prompt: 打开 https://www.baidu.com 告诉我搜索框的占位提示文字
notes: Real Chinese site nav + element extraction. Light-tier contract should validate finalUrl + grounded URL list.

prompt: 打开 https://example.com 点击 More information 链接，告诉我跳转后的页面标题
notes: Two-step click + read. final_url ledger entry should reflect iana.org, not example.com.

prompt: 打开 https://www.bing.com，把 'AI' 这两个字符输入到搜索框，但不要点击搜索按钮，把输入完成后的状态告诉我
notes: Tests the agent obeys the explicit no-submit constraint. Contract.constraints (light tier) auto-includes no_form_submit so verifier would flag if a form_submit ledger entry shows up.

prompt: 打开 https://compass.jinritemai.com 如果需要登录就停下来等用户操作
notes: Login park gate using a known-reliable target (compass.jinritemai.com — same site as P0_006). After the Phase 1 follow-up fix, supercar park writes executionMode='browser' to result so lane attribution is correct.

prompt: 打开 https://example.com 然后告诉我当前页面的完整 URL 是什么
notes: Direct URL self-report. The agent's final answer should literally cite the URL it visited; URL grounding should pass cleanly.
